visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an outdoor shot of a minimalist white building with a vertical slat facade and a white cat-shaped logo on the wall. A glass door features colorful posters advertising food and beverages. (2) Transition to a close-up of a promotional poster showing images of waffles and drinks with various text descriptions. (3) Inside the establishment, the scene shows a clean white interior with small round white tables and minimalist lighting. Korean script is visible on the wall. (4) A sequence of food preparation follows: dark liquid is poured into a cup of ice, green tea batter is ladled into a waffle iron, and the iron is closed. (5) Pink-colored cream is spread onto a thick waffle, followed by chocolate sauce. A person's hands are shown squeezing the finished waffle, causing the cream to bulge. (6) A young woman with short dark hair and a white necklace is shown drinking through a green straw and taking a large bite of a waffle. (7) Finally, two hands hold up packaged waffles in front of the shop's sign, and the screen transitions to the brand logos for TSUJIRI and Baek-Hu-Won on a light grey background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively female voice narrates in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by upbeat acoustic-pop background music featuring steady guitar strumming and a light drum beat. (2) A splashing sound effect triggers as liquid pours into ice, integrated smoothly into the mix. (3) A distinct metallic sizzling sound occurs as a waffle iron closes, punctuating the narration. (4) The narrator's pitch rises with excitement while describing the chocolate sauce, followed immediately by a squishing/crunching sound effect as the waffle is compressed. (5) The audio concludes with a warm recommendation and a closing signature tone from the narrator as the background music fades out over the brand logos.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a limited-time collaboration between the TSUJIRI tea brand and the Baek-Hu-Won waffle shop, highlighting new menu items like specialty waffles and drinks.
